messages:
maya: Heads up — onboarding CI failed for model 'orca-mini-4b' at the tokenizer step. Error says token mismatch and tests can't find weights. Anyone owning this model?

trent: I took a look. We do have weights uploaded but the model repo layout changed last week. Current S3 path: `s3://redwood-models/onboard/orca-mini-4b/2026-03-12/weights.pt`. CI was still pointing at the older date. Also noticed tokenizer config is adding BOS twice.

maya: thanks. Do you know whether the tokenizer actually uses `<s>` as BOS or a literal `<bos>` token? CI logs show an extra `<s>` at the start of every sample which shifts positions.

trent: tokenizer.json from the model bundle shows: ```json
{
  "special_tokens_map": {
    "bos_token": "<s>",
    "eos_token": "</s>",
    "pad_token": "<pad>"
  },
  "add_bos_token": true
}
```
But our chat template code also prepends `<s>` manually for system messages, so when we call `tokenizer.encode(..., add_special_tokens=True)` you get two leading `<s>`.

anya: FYI the onboarding README had an example chat template that explicitly included `<s>` and `</s>` around roles. That's probably the source of the double-BOS pattern. We should update templates to use placeholders and rely on the tokenizer to insert special tokens. I'll open a tiny PR to change examples.

liam: Good catch. We should also add a config lint that fails onboarding if `add_bos_token==true` AND templates include explicit `<s>`/`</s>`. I'll add a rule to the model-config validator.

maya: Action items: 1) trent - update CI path to the new S3 key and re-run onboarding. 2) anya - PR to sanitize chat templates. 3) liam - add validation rule to config lint. Mention me when PRs are ready and I'll trigger the re-onboard.

trent: will do. Quick patch I ran locally to force `add_bos_token=false` in the loader to confirm: ```python
# model_loader patch (temp)
config["add_bos_token"] = False
tokens = tokenizer.encode(prompt, add_special_tokens=True)
```
This removed the duplicate `<s>` in generated samples.

infra-bot: Created ticket RD-4527: "onboarding: detect conflicting tokenizer special token usage in templates + config" and assigned to liam.

deploy-bot: Staging CI re-run queued after weights path update.

maya: Great. If staging passes, we'll promote. Also note: for future onboarding checklists include an explicit step to verify tokenizer special_tokens_map vs template artifacts (BOS/EOS/pad). Small mistakes here cause subtle off-by-one bugs in embeddings and causal caches. :warning: 

liam: Adding checklist entry now. Will include a small unit test that encodes a 2-token prompt and asserts no duplicate BOS when using the canonical template.

anya: PR opened: #1287 — removes explicit `<s>`/`</s>` from examples and adds a comment about letting tokenizer manage special tokens.

trent: Updated CI path and re-triggered onboarding. Will report back in this thread when the run finishes. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team — appreciate the quick triage.
